assumptions: Coordinates, LOS boxes, radii and CC mapping are fixtures, not shipped map or engine behavior.
No player movement/pathfinding/combat damage is simulated.
A successful switch locks that beacon for 35 seconds; this is a doc61 proposal, not a user lock.
